title: 11.9.2: Key Equations
originalText:
Key Equations

            Formula for a factorial	
            \(\begin{matrix}0!=1\\1!=1\\n!=n(n−1)(n−2)⋯(2)(1), forn≥2\end{matrix}\)	

            recursive formula for nth term of an arithmetic sequence	
            \({a}_{n}={a}_{n−1}+d,n≥2\)	

            explicit formula for nth term of an arithmetic sequence	
            \(\begin{matrix}{a}_{n}={a}_{1}+d(n−1)\end{matrix}\)	

            recursive formula for \(nth\) term of a geometric sequence	
            \({a}_{n}=r{a}_{n−1},n≥2\)	

            explicit formula for \(nth\) term of a geometric sequence	
            \({a}_{n}={a}_{1}{r}^{n−1}\)	

            sum of the first \(n\) terms of an arithmetic series	
            \({S}_{n}=\frac{n({a}_{1}+{a}_{n})}{2}\)	

            sum of the first \(n\) terms of a geometric series	
            \({S}_{n}=\frac{{a}_{1}(1−{r}^{n})}{1−r},r≠1\)	

            sum of an infinite geometric series with \(–1<r< 1\)	
            \({S}_{n}=\frac{{a}_{1}}{1−r},r≠1\)	

            number of permutations of \(n\) distinct objects taken \(r\) at a time	
            \(P(n,r)=\frac{n!}{(n−r)!}\)	

            number of combinations of \(n\) distinct objects taken \(r\) at a time	
            \(C(n,r)=\frac{n!}{r!(n−r)!}\)	

            number of permutations of \(n\) non-distinct objects	
            \(\frac{n!}{{r}_{1}!{r}_{2}!…{r}_{k}!}\)	

            Binomial Theorem	
            \({(x+y)}^{n}=\munderover{∑}{k−0}{n}(\begin{matrix}n\\k\end{matrix}){x}^{n−k}{y}^{k}\)	

            \((r+1)th\) term of a binomial expansion	
            \((\begin{matrix}n\\r\end{matrix}){x}^{n−r}{y}^{r}\)	

            probability of an event with equally likely outcomes	
            \(P(E)=\frac{n(E)}{n(S)}\)	

            probability of the union of two events	
            \(P(E∪F)=P(E)+P(F)−P(E∩F)\)	

            probability of the union of mutually exclusive events	
            \(P(E∪F)=P(E)+P(F)\)	

            probability of the complement of an event	
            \(P(E')=1−P(E)\)
